body:
Context: Issue #605. In packages/consensus-fix/lib/runner.mjs, runCommand() hardcodes spawn("sh", ["-c", cmd]) and folds spawn ENOENT errors into exitCode 127 without surfacing spawnError, so on Windows where sh is absent the pre-flight "confirm test fails" check treats ENOENT as a normal test failure, fans N paid LLM completions, and then fails every candidate. Separately, packages/consensus-fix/lib/region.mjs derives the filename with filePath.split("/").pop(), which fails to strip directory components on Windows backslash paths.
Changes:
1. In packages/consensus-fix/lib/runner.mjs, add shellInvocation(cmd, platform = process.platform) returning { file: "cmd", args: ["/d", "/s", "/c", cmd] } on win32 and { file: "sh", args: ["-c", cmd] } otherwise; surface spawnError (err.code || err.message) on child "error" events in runCommand(); and in runConsensusFix(), throw an operational error (isOpError: true) if initialRun.spawnError is set so pre-flight aborts before fanning LLM completions when the shell cannot be spawned.
2. In packages/consensus-fix/lib/region.mjs, extract fileBasename(filePath) splitting on both "/" and "\\" so Windows paths window around stack-trace line references identically to POSIX paths.
3. Add unit tests in packages/consensus-fix/test/runner.test.mjs and packages/consensus-fix/test/region.test.mjs covering shellInvocation, spawnError handling and pre-flight abort before completeFn, and Windows backslash paths in buildFileExcerpt.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AC1: shellInvocation selects cmd /d /s /c on win32 and sh -c on POSIX; runConsensusFix throws an operational error before invoking completeFn when initialRun reports a spawnError.
- AC2: buildFileExcerpt windows files referenced by basename when filePath uses Windows backslashes.
- AC3: node --test packages/consensus-fix/test/*.test.mjs and mutation-gate pass.
title: fix(consensus-fix): support Windows shell command execution, ENOENT pre-flight guard, and path basename windowing (#605)
